name: Minor Corruption
description: GM only. A Sorcerer's Wild Surge: the GM rolls d20 in secret, 1 is Major Corruption and 2 to 20 Minor, then d100 here (Monsters & Treasure, Sorcerer's Corruption). The Sorcerer's own save against its surge is DC 12; others use its spell DC.
